title: Our Economy is about to EXPLODE | Agentic AI SHOCK
speaker: Kevin Paffrath

macro_themes.view: Technology business activity is expanding at its fastest pace since June 2021 and all sectors are expanding, so the economy is booming on AI spend.

macro_themes.theme: Two canaries: labor and AI underwriters
macro_themes.view: As long as the labor market and the AI end-buyers (OpenAI, Anthropic) stay healthy, stay bullish stocks; labor rolling over would crash the economy.
10-year near 5.32% and 2s10s near 50bp 'shock territory' raise risk; be cautious/nervous but not fearful, driven by supply rather than bond bears.
Hedge by limiting stock allocation and diversifying into real estate, private equity, debt payoff and cash rather than trying to time a black swan.
The ratio is reversing a 5-year downtrend, signaling economic boom, and should keep widening despite Treasury fears.

calls.condition: Upside acceleration to 800 tied to a deal with Iran and more AI news; bullishness holds as long as both canaries stay healthy.
calls.reason: Economy booming on AI spend, labor market rebounding; bought the 700 dip as peak fear and expects continued all-time highs ahead of a bigger euphoria.
calls.quote: That's why I think we continue to drive uh all-time highs on the cues.
